entities.name: Carl Magnus von Hell
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carl Magnus von Hell was the German chemist who discovered, together with Jacob Volhard and the Russian chemist Nikolay Zelinsky, the Hell–Volhard–Zelinsky halogenation reaction.
